title: Within-visit systolic-pressure variability does not improve transferred DSST prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: In 1,390 NHANES 2013–2014 adults aged 60 or older, adding log within-visit systolic-pressure SD to a source-fitted demographic/education/mean-pressure model worsened weighted DSST MSE by 0.5864 points squared; the gain interval (-3.0408, 0.2901) included zero. Incremental predictive value was not established.
